name: Abandoning Friends
overview: Scripture reveals the painful reality of friends abandoning one another, as seen in Job's lament that even his closest companions have forgotten him and in the betrayal of a trusted friend who turns against him. The Psalms acknowledge that abandonment by loved ones can occur, yet God promises to gather and uphold those forsaken. Proverbs contrasts the fickleness of human friendships, often influenced by wealth, with the steadfast love of a true friend who remains loyal in adversity. Together, these verses underscore both the frailty of human relationships and the enduring faithfulness found in God and genuine friendship.
